name: Petőfiszállás (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with a narrow yellow stripe along each side edge, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Petőfiszállás (a quartered shield of red and blue with a helm and red and blue mantling) above the name PETŐFISZÁLLÁS in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Petőfiszállás arms with helm and mantling
